title: Connect an optional Discord panel
subtitle: Current GoNuts interface · optional connection
captionText: The Discord panel is optional and separate from the browser panel. Use your own bot and operator account. The written Discord guide covers the external application and permissions steps.

title: Prepare your Discord application
subtitle: Current GoNuts interface · optional connection
bullets: Invite it with the documented permissions
captionText: In the Discord developer portal, create your application and bot, then invite it using the permissions in the written guide. External portal screens are not shown here. Never post a token in chat, a report or a screenshot.

title: Copy channel and operator IDs
subtitle: Current GoNuts interface · optional connection
captionText: Enable Developer Mode in Discord. Copy the target channel ID and your own user ID. Names and channel links do not replace numeric IDs.

title: Open the current GoNuts controls
subtitle: Current GoNuts interface · optional connection
bullets: Cycle Tools to Discord command centre
captionText: Press B, choose Trading, then Trade. Cycle the top Tools button to Discord command centre and open it. These are the current client controls.

title: Save the connection details
subtitle: Current GoNuts interface · optional connection
bullets: Paste token in the masked field
Set channel ID and operator user ID
captionText: Enter your token in the masked Bot token field, Channel id and Your Discord user id. Save and read the connection status. Keep credentials out of screenshots. Optional activity feed settings are separate.

title: Choose the account you mean
subtitle: Current GoNuts interface · optional connection
captionText: The Discord, local and hosted panels share the same image renderer. Select one account or All accounts. Money includes order funds, unfilled orders and observed completion counts alongside auction results. Filled orders are delivered stock, not sales or profit.
